title: ecofren
tagline: make sustainable lifestyle fun again!  smart moves can be fun via gaming
description:
This document describes an interactive game designed to help people move towards an eco-social lifestyle.  The game is called  "ecofren" in English.  It explores themes such as materials, movement, energy, ownership, and well-being.  The game encourages players to reflect on their consumption habits and consider more sustainable alternatives. 

The  hidden agenda of the game is to educate commons to enter the web3-space. Tools like dWallets are essential, there should be a great reason to use them. Gaming is a natural method to rise interest, especially with the connection with sustainability and DeFi.  

The game should inspire individuals and it is supposed to be fun.  It aims to promote a lifestyle that is both ecologically sound and socially responsible.  The game is designed to be non-judgmental and encourages players to realistically assess their daily choices.

The game could benefit from AI assessing the questions and statements and even giving some easy tasks during the game to activate physical actions during the game. The production of the game is related to values that aim for sustainability in every area of influence. At the same time, the game should be entertaining and slightly challenging. Typical features of the games can be used. One idea is to fit the game into some existing and well-known imaginary environment.
how_its_made:
This game is a small part of a larger whole and can be implemented within this short timeframe: at least some features of it.
Technical details are open and will be defined after the team is established. 
The game will be build on web3 and it will benefit from AI. 
The information and the features will be added at the time the project evolves.

Dev tools: arbitrum stylus for SC development and foundry's cast
Network: arbitrum sepolia 
Programming languages: rust, typescript 
Libraries: react, nodejs, wagmi, and phaser
AI-tools: Synthesia, Gemini, Grok
Databases: supabase (with postgresql) 
Design: Figma, Figma-libraries
